title: Software Developer - SME Workflow Applications
purpose: Build and maintain order, inventory and customer workflow applications for small business clients in Singapore.
criteria: C1
At least 24 distinct calendar months of commercial software development. Paid contracts and internships count; personal projects do not.
C2
Evidence of implementing backend business logic and HTTP APIs in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript.
C3
Evidence of SQL queries, relational data modelling or database migrations in a delivered application.
C4
Evidence of both Git-based collaboration and automated software tests.
preferred: Relevant certification, if stated and current
education: Relevant qualification or equivalent practical experience. A degree is not mandatory.
responsibilities: Implement backend features and data integrations.
Maintain database changes, tests and code reviews.
Work with SME operations staff to clarify requirements.

title: Sales Operations Executive - B2B Services
purpose: Maintain a reliable B2B sales pipeline, prepare weekly reports and coordinate accurate quotes and handovers.
criteria: C1
At least 12 distinct calendar months supporting B2B sales operations or B2B sales administration. Paid internships count.
C2
Evidence of maintaining CRM customer, opportunity or pipeline records.
C3
Evidence of spreadsheet sales reporting using pivot tables or lookup functions.
C4
Evidence of preparing B2B quotations and coordinating customer follow-up or order handover.
preferred: HubSpot, Salesforce or Zoho experience; equivalent CRMs are acceptable
Relevant certification, if stated and current
education: Business-related qualification or equivalent practical experience. A degree is not mandatory.
responsibilities: Keep opportunity stages and customer records current.
Produce weekly pipeline and sales reports.
Coordinate quotations, follow-ups and delivery handovers.

title: Accounts Assistant - SME Finance Operations
purpose: Support accurate supplier payments, customer collections and month-end bookkeeping for a small distributor.
criteria: C1
At least 12 distinct calendar months of bookkeeping or accounts support. Paid internships count.
C2
Evidence of both accounts payable and accounts receivable tasks.
C3
Evidence of performing bank reconciliations and investigating differences.
C4
Evidence of using both spreadsheets and accounting software for finance tasks.
preferred: Relevant certification, if stated and current
education: Accounting-related qualification or equivalent practical experience. A degree is not mandatory.
responsibilities: Process invoices, receipts and payment records.
Reconcile bank activity and investigate exceptions.
Maintain working papers and support month-end close.
